release_summary: New finance and scheduling KPIs, plus clearer revenue and lead labels
release_details: Finance and revenue now includes Net Income Margin, Revenue Trend vs. Prev Month, and a renamed Billed Revenue (Run-Rate) chart. Scheduling adds Appointment Confirmation Rate and Avg. Check-In to Check-Out, and Lead to Appointment Conversion replaces the old lead conversion name. Enter monthly values for the new KPIs under Administration - NMAC master.
